purpose: Turn a small public/internal contract subset from P4-25 into a machine-checkable future apply preflight without implementing the mirror or changing old anchors.

subset_policy.selection_reason: Choose a small, high-leverage contract subset that defines public package/runtime boundaries and the internal enforcement rules that keep those public boundaries honest.

selected_subset.why_selected: Defines what RedCap can safely expose as runtime/public contract before npm/CLI release.
Defines the runtime/workspace boundary a new user must understand without knowing Norven's local machine.
Defines which files and user-facing promises may appear in the public package surface.
Defines the release safety boundary that prevents private data, credentials, raw evidence, or local-only material from entering a package.
Keeps public claims tied to machine-enforced internal guarantees instead of narrative promises.
Defines which checks are hard gates and which evidence can drift after clean E2E, protecting release readiness from false positives.
Keeps mid-task continuation and inserted requirements from hijacking the public release path.

required_before_apply: Prism review must approve the exact subset and future target paths.
clean workspace E2E must pass after any future copy-first implementation.
Old references/* anchors must remain readable until a later delete-last task proves no consumers rely on them.
Public package surface and package publish safety checks must still pass.
No release switch, license, registry, credential or package privacy change may be bundled into the copy-first apply.
rollback_plan: If a future target copy causes package surface drift, remove only the copied contracts/* target and keep the original references/* anchor.
If public/internal classification is disputed, revert the copied target and return to P4-25/P4-27 manifests as the source of truth.
If any validator starts reading contracts/* prematurely, block the apply and add an explicit consumer migration preflight.
stop_conditions: Any proposed operation deletes, moves, renames, replaces, or symlink-switches an old anchor.
Any proposed operation changes package publish settings, credentials, registry, license, package privacy, or release switches.
Any proposed operation cleans Prism raw evidence or decides Layer A product scope.
Any proposed report claims internal-control-plane or public release readiness is resolved by this preflight.

claim_boundary.allowed_user_claim: P4-27 completed a small public/internal contract apply preflight. No files were copied, moved, deleted, or published.
forbidden_claims: The contract mirror has been physically implemented.
The selected files have been copied to contracts/.
Old references anchors have been retired, deleted, moved, replaced, or redirected.
Prism raw run evidence has been cleaned or pruned.
Layer A product scope has been decided.
RedCap is ready for formal public release.

result.next_recommended_slice: P4-28 route selection after P4-27 preflight
